typography.$description: Text roles, each a utility class type-<role> that sets family, weight, size, line height and letter spacing together. The Figma file has no text styles; these are the styles its final admin and player screens actually use (research 08f, section 5). Adjust weight with font-* only where a role says so (for example an active tab).

wordmark.$description: Admin wordmark 'intlabs.' (Poppins Black 32 on Poppins' own 1.5 line, the 48 px Figma text box; the gradient fill comes from the Wordmark component).

wordmark-player.$description: Player wordmark 'LIFE Bank.' (Poppins ExtraBold 28 on a 1.5 line, the 42 px Figma text box).

page-title.$description: Page titles: 'Simulations', 'Retail Mass - Loan' (Poppins 30; SemiBold, where Figma draws Regular, so the title leads the page, with -1% tracking).

modal-title.$description: Modal titles: 'Start Round?', 'Change your password' (Poppins SemiBold 30).

section-title.$description: Section titles inside a page: 'Event', 'Team List' (Poppins 24; SemiBold, where Figma draws Regular, with -1% tracking).

panel-title.$description: Titles of the player's panels and cards: 'Set Your Strategy Inputs', 'Select your Initiatives' (Poppins SemiBold 20, Figma 'XL (poppins)/Semi Bold').

heading.$description: Card titles: 'Simulation Summary', the segment card's panels (Poppins SemiBold 18).

heading-sm.$description: Small card titles: chart titles (Poppins Medium 16).

tab.$description: Underline tabs (Poppins Medium 18, where Figma draws Regular; the active tab adds font-semibold).

kpi-label.$description: KPI bar labels: 'Overall Revenue' (Poppins Regular 16, letter spacing -1%).

kpi-value.$description: KPI bar values: '$99.99 Bn' (Poppins SemiBold 16, letter spacing -1% as the labels, measured on Navbar Variant2).

stat.$description: Large numbers in tiles and summaries (Poppins SemiBold 24).

interstitial.$description: A message across the screen while the game moves on: 'New round is starting!' (Figma's Inter Regular 48, set in Poppins Regular, the display family, on a 1.2 line).

body-lg.$description: Table cells, inputs, descriptions in decision rows (Source Sans Regular 16/24).

body.$description: Navigation items, descriptions, breadcrumb (Source Sans Regular 14/20).

label.$description: Form labels, values and placeholders: 'Current Password*' (Source Sans Regular 15 on the 19 px line the Figma text boxes measure; a label, 10 px, then the 47 px field make Figma's 76 px field).

button.$description: Button labels: '+ New Simulation', 'Submit' (Source Sans SemiBold 15). Figma sets outline buttons in Inter; the design system uses Source Sans for every button.

caption.$description: Emails, ids, tooltips, chart axes (Source Sans Regular 12/16).

badge.$description: Status badges: 'ACTIVE' (Source Sans Regular 10/16; the text is written in capitals).

overline.$description: Group labels: 'SIMULATION MANAGEMENT' (Source Sans SemiBold 10/16, uppercase, 1.2 px letter spacing).

hint.$description: 'Previous: $5k' under a decision input (Source Sans Italic 14/20).

modal-body.$description: Modal body text: 'Choose a new password...' (Source Sans Regular 18 on the 23 px line of the Figma text box).
